senses.en: a short summary of a research paper or report
senses.pattern: write an abstract / submit an abstract / read the abstract / the abstract of a paper
senses.example: Before reading the whole paper, she checked the [[abstract]] to see whether it was relevant to her research.
senses.example_zh: 在讀整篇論文之前，她先看了摘要，確認內容是否與自己的研究有關。
senses.note: 指論文、報告開頭的內容摘要

senses.en: special importance or emphasis given to something
senses.pattern: the accent is on sth / put the accent on sth / with the accent on sth
senses.example: At this cooking school, the [[accent]] is on fresh local ingredients rather than complicated techniques.
senses.example_zh: 這所烹飪學校的重點在於新鮮的在地食材，而不是複雜的技巧。

senses.en: to make something more noticeable
senses.pattern: accent a feature / accent sth with sth / be accented with sth
senses.example: The designer chose bright yellow cushions to [[accent]] the plain gray sofa in the living room.
senses.example_zh: 設計師選了鮮黃色的抱枕，來突顯客廳裡素雅的灰色沙發。
senses.note: 同義詞 accentuate 更常見

senses.en: a government department responsible for a particular area
senses.pattern: a government agency / a space agency / an environmental protection agency
senses.example: The national weather [[agency]] warned that the typhoon could bring record rainfall to the east coast.
senses.example_zh: 國家氣象署警告，這個颱風可能為東岸帶來破紀錄的雨量。

senses.en: the ability to act and make your own choices
senses.pattern: a sense of agency / human agency / moral agency
senses.example: Letting students choose their own research topics gives them a stronger sense of [[agency]] in learning.
senses.example_zh: 讓學生自選研究主題，能增強他們在學習上的自主性。

gsat.sentence: Environmental Protection [[Agency]] (EPA), medical waste is a major source of dioxin pollution in the country.

senses.en: acting with great energy and determination to succeed
senses.pattern: aggressive marketing / an aggressive sales strategy / an aggressive campaign
senses.example: The company launched an [[aggressive]] marketing campaign to win more young customers before the holiday season.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司推出強勢的行銷活動，要在假期前贏得更多年輕顧客。

senses.en: (of a disease) developing or spreading very quickly
senses.pattern: an aggressive cancer / an aggressive tumor / an aggressive form of the disease
senses.example: Doctors found that she had an [[aggressive]] form of cancer and began treatment immediately.
senses.example_zh: 醫師發現她罹患的是一種惡化快速的癌症，便立刻開始治療。

senses.en: different from the usual or traditional kind
senses.pattern: alternative medicine / alternative music / an alternative lifestyle
senses.example: Tired of taking pills, she turned to [[alternative]] medicine such as acupuncture and herbal tea.
senses.example_zh: 她厭倦了吃藥，轉而求助針灸、花草茶等另類療法。

gsat.sentence: Since the 1990s, [[alternative]] proms have been organized in some areas to meet the needs of particular students.
According to the passage, what gave rise to [[alternative]] proms?

senses.en: to believe that something is important or valuable
senses.pattern: attach importance to / attach great value to / attach significance to
senses.example: Many parents [[attach]] great importance to grades, yet children also need time to play and rest.
senses.example_zh: 許多父母非常重視成績，但孩子也需要時間玩耍和休息。
senses.note: attach A to B，A 為 importance 等名詞

senses.en: (be attached to) to like someone or something very much
senses.pattern: be attached to sb / grow attached to / be deeply attached to
senses.example: After three years in the mountain village, the young teacher had grown deeply [[attached]] to the place and its people.
senses.example_zh: 在山村待了三年後，這位年輕老師已深深依戀這個地方和當地的人。
senses.note: 常用被動 be attached to

senses.en: a document promising to repay borrowed money with interest
senses.pattern: government bonds / buy bonds / issue bonds / stocks and bonds
senses.example: My grandfather put most of his savings into government [[bonds]] because he considered them safer than stocks.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺把大部分的積蓄拿去買政府債券，因為他認為債券比股票安全。

senses.en: to join two things firmly together
senses.pattern: bond A to B / bond with sth / bond together
senses.example: This glue is strong enough to [[bond]] metal to glass in less than a minute.
senses.example_zh: 這種膠的黏性很強，不到一分鐘就能把金屬和玻璃牢牢黏合。

gsat.sentence: De Mestral’s first challenge was finding a fabric for a strong [[bonding]] system.

senses.en: to cause a feeling or situation to develop
senses.pattern: breed distrust / breed violence / breed resentment / breed confidence
senses.example: Success achieved too easily can [[breed]] a dangerous sense of overconfidence in young athletes.
senses.example_zh: 太容易得來的成功，可能會在年輕運動員身上引起危險的過度自信。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 bred

senses.en: a particular type of person or thing
senses.pattern: a new breed of / a rare breed / a dying breed
senses.example: A new [[breed]] of young farmers is using drones and sensors to grow rice.
senses.example_zh: 有一種新類型的年輕農夫，正利用無人機和感測器來種稻。

gsat.sentence: This new [[breed]] of online classes is shaking up the higher education world in many ways.

senses.en: a series of planned military attacks
senses.pattern: a military campaign / a bombing campaign / a winter campaign
senses.example: The general's winter [[campaign]] failed because his soldiers ran short of food and warm clothing.
senses.example_zh: 這位將軍的冬季戰役因士兵缺乏糧食與禦寒衣物而失敗。

senses.zh: 發起運動；從事競選活動
senses.en: to take part in organized action for a social or political goal
senses.pattern: campaign for equal rights / campaign against smoking / campaign to save the forest
senses.example: Local residents have [[campaigned]] for years for a safer crossing in front of the elementary school.
senses.example_zh: 當地居民多年來持續發起運動，爭取在小學前設置更安全的行人穿越道。

senses.en: the series of numbers used to open a lock
senses.pattern: a combination lock / the combination to the safe / forget the combination
senses.example: Only the manager knows the [[combination]] to the safe where the day's cash is kept.
senses.example_zh: 只有經理知道保險箱的密碼，當天收到的現金都存放在裡面。

senses.en: a group of people sharing a job, interest, or background
senses.pattern: the scientific community / the business community / the international community
senses.example: The discovery was welcomed by the scientific [[community]], which had searched for an answer for decades.
senses.example_zh: 這項發現受到科學界的歡迎，科學界尋找答案已有數十年之久。

senses.en: all the plants and animals living in one area
senses.pattern: a plant community / marine communities / a community of microbes
senses.example: Pollution from the factory has damaged the [[community]] of fish and plants living in the lake.
senses.example_zh: 工廠的污染已破壞了湖中由魚類與植物構成的生物群落。

gsat.sentence: In the sixteenth century, when the Africans were taken from their homes to Brazil against their will and kept in slavery, Capoeira began to take form among the [[community]] of slaves for self-defense.

In addition to traditional course materials such as videos, readings, and problem sets, MOOCs provide interactive user forums that help build a [[community]] for the students, professors, and teaching assistants.

senses.en: the amount of a substance in a liquid or mixture
senses.pattern: a high concentration of salt / carbon dioxide concentration / blood sugar concentration
senses.example: The [[concentration]] of salt in the Dead Sea is so high that swimmers float easily.
senses.example_zh: 死海的鹽濃度非常高，游泳的人很容易就能浮起來。

senses.en: a large number of things gathered in one place
senses.pattern: a concentration of factories / the concentration of wealth / a heavy concentration of
senses.example: The city has the highest [[concentration]] of bookstores in the country, with over forty on one street.
senses.example_zh: 這座城市是全國書店最密集的地方，光是一條街就有四十多家。

gsat.sentence: They found that lowering GABA levels in zebrafish can trigger retina regeneration, while a high level of GABA [[concentration]] will suppress the regeneration process.

senses.en: a substance that lets heat or electricity pass through
senses.pattern: a good conductor of heat / a poor conductor / a conductor of electricity
senses.example: Copper is such a good [[conductor]] of electricity that it is used in most household wires.
senses.example_zh: 銅是極佳的電導體，因此大多數家用電線都使用它。

senses.en: a person who checks tickets on a train or bus
senses.pattern: a train conductor / a bus conductor / show the conductor your ticket
senses.example: The [[conductor]] walked through the train, checking every passenger's ticket before the next stop.
senses.example_zh: 列車長走過車廂，在下一站之前查驗每位乘客的車票。

senses.en: a person's general health and physical strength
senses.pattern: a strong constitution / a weak constitution / a delicate constitution
senses.example: The doctor warned that someone with such a delicate [[constitution]] should avoid working night shifts.
senses.example_zh: 醫生提醒，體質這麼虛弱的人應避免上夜班。

senses.en: the way something is formed or made up
senses.pattern: the constitution of the committee / genetic constitution / the constitution of the board
senses.example: Parents questioned the [[constitution]] of the committee, which included no teachers or student representatives at all.
senses.example_zh: 家長質疑該委員會的組成，因為其中完全沒有教師或學生代表。

senses.en: extremely important to how things will develop
senses.pattern: be critical to success / a critical factor / play a critical role
senses.example: Getting enough sleep is [[critical]] to students' memory and their performance on exams.
senses.example_zh: 充足的睡眠對學生的記憶力和考試表現極為關鍵。

senses.en: very serious or dangerous; possibly near death
senses.pattern: in critical condition / a critical shortage / critically ill
senses.example: Two passengers remain in [[critical]] condition after the bus crashed into a bridge last night.
senses.example_zh: 昨晚公車撞上橋梁後，兩名乘客目前傷勢仍然危急。

gsat.sentence: As blood supplies have fallen to a [[critically]] low level, many hospitals are making an appeal for the public to donate blood.
As the world population continues to grow, shortages of fresh water will occur more often and the need for additional water supplies will become [[critical]].

senses.en: to tell officials about taxable goods or income
senses.pattern: declare goods at customs / declare your income / nothing to declare
senses.example: Travelers carrying large amounts of cash must [[declare]] it to customs officers on arrival.
senses.example_zh: 攜帶大量現金的旅客，入境時必須向海關人員申報。

senses.en: to make someone worried or upset
senses.pattern: be deeply disturbed by / be disturbed to learn / it disturbs sb that
senses.example: Parents were deeply [[disturbed]] by reports that some students had been bullied online for months.
senses.example_zh: 有報導指出部分學生遭網路霸凌長達數月，這使家長深感不安。
senses.note: 形容詞 disturbing＝令人不安的

senses.en: to change the normal state or position of something
senses.pattern: disturb the balance / disturb sleep patterns / disturb the peace / disturb the soil
senses.example: Please don't [[disturb]] the papers on my desk; I have arranged them in a special order.
senses.example_zh: 請不要弄亂我桌上的文件，我是照特定順序排好的。

gsat.sentence: There never seemed to be enough time to go to church, which [[disturbed]] some friends and relatives.

Furthermore, watching horror movies can [[disturb]] sleep patterns, as the residual fear and anxiety they evoke may keep people awake all night, thus leading to fatigue and irritability the following day.

senses.en: to continue to exist for a long time
senses.pattern: endure for centuries / endure to this day / an enduring friendship
senses.example: The tradition of giving red envelopes to children has [[endured]] for hundreds of years.
senses.example_zh: 發紅包給小孩的傳統已經持續了數百年。

gsat.sentence: The belief that rapid speech and lying go together is also widespread and [[enduring]].
Exposure of one’s inner thoughts is essential for [[enduring]] relationships.

senses.en: to have people as guests and give them food
senses.pattern: entertain guests / entertain clients / entertain friends at home
senses.example: My grandparents love to [[entertain]] relatives at home with a big dinner every Lunar New Year.
senses.example_zh: 我祖父母喜歡每年農曆新年在家準備豐盛的晚餐款待親戚。

senses.en: to consider or keep an idea, hope, or doubt
senses.pattern: entertain an idea / entertain a hope / entertain doubts / entertain the possibility
senses.example: The manager refused to even [[entertain]] the idea of closing the store on weekends.
senses.example_zh: 經理甚至拒絕考慮週末不營業的想法。

senses.en: the experience of coming into contact with something
senses.pattern: exposure to new ideas / early exposure to music / gain exposure to other cultures
senses.example: Growing up in a port city gave Hana early [[exposure]] to many languages and cuisines.
senses.example_zh: 在港口城市長大，讓哈娜很早就接觸到多種語言與料理。

senses.en: attention from newspapers, television, or the internet
senses.pattern: media exposure / gain exposure / get national exposure
senses.example: The young band gained wide [[exposure]] after their song was used in a popular television drama.
senses.example_zh: 這個年輕樂團的歌曲被一部熱門電視劇採用後，獲得了大量的媒體曝光。

gsat.sentence: Worse yet, [[exposure]] to graphic violence and bloodshed can make them less sensitive to real-life violence and more accepting of aggression.
Recent or repeated [[exposure]] to a song or even a small part of a song can also trigger earworms, as can word associations, such as a phrase similar to the lyrics of a song.

senses.en: to offer a welcome, thanks, or an invitation
senses.pattern: extend a warm welcome / extend an invitation / extend our thanks / extend help to
senses.example: On behalf of the school, I would like to [[extend]] a warm welcome to our exchange students.
senses.example_zh: 我謹代表學校，向各位交換學生表達熱烈的歡迎。

senses.en: to include or apply to someone or something
senses.pattern: extend to / extend beyond / extend to all members
senses.example: The ban on plastic straws now [[extends]] to all night markets and food stalls in the city.
senses.example_zh: 塑膠吸管的禁令現在適用於全市所有夜市和小吃攤。

senses.en: a particular arrangement or pattern of people or things
senses.pattern: fly in formation / in a V formation / a battle formation / march in close formation
senses.example: Every autumn, wild geese fly south in a V [[formation]] to save energy on the long journey.
senses.example_zh: 每年秋天，野雁排成 V 字隊形南飛，以便在長途飛行中節省體力。
senses.note: in formation 意為「排成隊形」

senses.en: something naturally formed, such as rocks or clouds
senses.pattern: rock formations / cloud formations / a limestone formation / coral formations
senses.example: Tourists come from around the world to photograph the strange rock [[formations]] along this stretch of coast.
senses.example_zh: 世界各地的遊客前來拍攝這段海岸沿線奇特的岩石構造。

senses.en: to feel that you share someone's feelings or situation
senses.pattern: identify with a character / identify with a group / identify strongly with
senses.example: Many teenage readers [[identify]] with the story's heroine because she struggles with the same worries.
senses.example_zh: 許多青少年讀者對故事的女主角很有共鳴，因為她也為同樣的煩惱所苦。

senses.en: to find or discover a cause, problem, or need
senses.pattern: identify the cause / identify a problem / identify areas for improvement / identify a need
senses.example: The survey helped the school [[identify]] three main reasons why students skip breakfast.
senses.example_zh: 這項調查幫助學校找出學生不吃早餐的三個主要原因。

gsat.sentence: People in this community tend to [[identify]] with the group they belong to, and often put group interests before personal ones.
There are still a lot of questions unanswered, but three main causes have been [[identified]].

senses.en: a religious leader in some Christian churches
senses.pattern: a church minister / a Christian minister / the minister's sermon
senses.example: The young couple asked the [[minister]] of their church to perform the wedding ceremony.
senses.example_zh: 這對年輕情侶請他們教會的牧師主持婚禮。

senses.en: minister to sb: to care for people in need
senses.pattern: minister to the sick / minister to sb's needs / minister to the poor
senses.example: Volunteer nurses [[ministered]] to the injured villagers until medical teams arrived from the city.
senses.example_zh: 志願護理人員照料受傷的村民，直到醫療團隊從市區趕來。

senses.en: a remark or comment about something you have noticed
senses.pattern: make an observation / an interesting observation / observations on sth
senses.example: The guest speaker made a witty [[observation]] about how teenagers talk less but text more.
senses.example_zh: 那位客座講者發表了一句風趣的評論，說青少年話變少、訊息卻傳得更多。

senses.en: (of money) not yet paid
senses.pattern: an outstanding debt / an outstanding balance / outstanding bills / outstanding loans
senses.example: He used his year-end bonus to pay off the [[outstanding]] debt on his motorcycle.
senses.example_zh: 他用年終獎金還清了機車尚未付清的欠款。

senses.en: not yet done, solved, or dealt with
senses.pattern: outstanding issues / outstanding problems / outstanding work
senses.example: The two sides will meet again next week to discuss several [[outstanding]] issues.
senses.example_zh: 雙方下週將再次會面，討論幾個尚未解決的問題。

senses.en: (of a feeling or smoke) to make someone weak or helpless
senses.pattern: be overcome with emotion / be overcome with grief / be overcome by smoke / be overcome by fumes
senses.example: When her name was announced as the winner, she was [[overcome]] with emotion and could not speak.
senses.example_zh: 當她的名字被宣布為得獎者時，她激動得受不了，說不出話來。
senses.note: 多用被動 be overcome by/with

senses.en: to have a view of something from above
senses.pattern: overlook the sea / overlook the valley / a room overlooking the park
senses.example: Our hotel room [[overlooked]] a quiet lake surrounded by pine trees and snow-capped mountains.
senses.example_zh: 我們的飯店房間俯瞰一座寧靜的湖，四周環繞著松樹和白雪覆頂的群山。

senses.en: to forgive or ignore someone's fault or mistake
senses.pattern: overlook a mistake / overlook sb's faults / overlook it this time
senses.example: The teacher agreed to [[overlook]] my lateness this time because the bus had broken down.
senses.example_zh: 老師同意這次不計較我遲到，因為公車拋錨了。

gsat.sentence: So we went to the restaurant and sat by a window [[overlooking]] the bay.
On a hilltop [[overlooking]] the 2011-tsunami hit Otsuchi Town in northeastern Japan, there is a white phone booth standing all alone in the wind.

senses.en: to look very carefully, especially when seeing is difficult
senses.pattern: peer at / peer into / peer through / peer over
senses.example: The little girl [[peered]] through the keyhole, trying to see what her parents were wrapping.
senses.example_zh: 小女孩透過鑰匙孔仔細看，想知道爸媽在包什麼東西。

senses.en: relating to real things that can be seen or touched
senses.pattern: physical evidence / a physical store / the physical world / a physical book
senses.example: The band's new album is sold online only, and no [[physical]] copies will be released.
senses.example_zh: 這個樂團的新專輯只在網路上販售，不會發行實體版。

senses.en: a medical examination of the whole body
senses.pattern: have a physical / an annual physical / pass a physical
senses.example: All new pilots must pass a strict [[physical]] before they are allowed to fly.
senses.example_zh: 所有新進飛行員都必須通過嚴格的健康檢查，才獲准飛行。

gsat.sentence: Though there is no [[physical]] evidence to support this, the word dakshina “south” in Indian languages also means “right,” suggesting that ancient Indians were oriented toward the east, and therefore south was on their right-hand side.

The feel of a book, the smell, the weight, and the knowledge that a particular book might be more than a hundred years old—all these highlight the importance of preserving the [[physical]] book as a complement to technology.

senses.en: a secret plan to do something harmful or illegal
senses.pattern: a plot to overthrow / uncover a plot / a plot against the king
senses.example: The guards uncovered a [[plot]] to steal the crown jewels during the royal parade.
senses.example_zh: 衛兵揭發了一樁企圖在皇家遊行期間竊取王冠珠寶的陰謀。
senses.note: 亦作動詞：plot to do sth 密謀做某事

senses.en: a small piece of land used for a purpose
senses.pattern: a plot of land / a vegetable plot / a building plot
senses.example: Each family in the community garden is given a small [[plot]] to grow vegetables.
senses.example_zh: 社區菜園裡的每戶人家都分到一小塊土地來種菜。

senses.en: to mark points or a route on a graph or map
senses.pattern: plot a course / plot a graph / plot the data / plot points on a map
senses.example: The students measured the plant's height every day and [[plotted]] the results on a graph.
senses.example_zh: 學生每天測量植物的高度，並在圖表上標出結果。

gsat.sentence: I remember that on my cruise I was required to formally [[plot]] our course, using the tide table, even though our goal was an island I could see quite clearly across the water in the distance.

senses.en: an area where wild animals or plants are protected
senses.pattern: a wildlife preserve / a nature preserve / a forest preserve
senses.example: Hunting is strictly forbidden inside the wildlife [[preserve]], where hundreds of deer roam freely.
senses.example_zh: 野生動物保護區內嚴禁打獵，數百頭鹿在裡面自由漫步。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式多用 reserve

senses.en: an activity or area limited to one group
senses.pattern: the preserve of the rich / a male preserve / remain the preserve of sb
senses.example: A century ago, university education was largely the [[preserve]] of wealthy families.
senses.example_zh: 一百年前，大學教育大多是富裕家庭的專屬領域。
senses.note: 複數 preserves 另指果醬、蜜餞

senses.en: the best or most active period of life
senses.pattern: in one's prime / the prime of life / past one's prime
senses.example: The tennis star retired in her [[prime]], just months after winning her third world title.
senses.example_zh: 這位網球明星在全盛時期退休，當時距離她贏得第三座世界冠軍才幾個月。

senses.en: of the best quality or in the best position
senses.pattern: a prime location / prime beef / a prime seat
senses.example: The café sits in a [[prime]] location right across from the city's busiest train station.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡館位於最好的地段，就在全市最繁忙的火車站對面。

gsat.sentence: The prickly pear cactus is such a powerful symbol in Mexico that it occupies a [[prime]] spot on Mexico’s national flag.

senses.en: to ask customers to return a faulty product
senses.pattern: recall a product / recall faulty cars / be recalled for safety reasons
senses.example: The company [[recalled]] thousands of baby strollers after several children were injured.
senses.example_zh: 在數名孩童受傷後，該公司召回了數千台嬰兒推車。

senses.en: the ability to remember things you have learned or experienced
senses.pattern: powers of recall / total recall / have excellent recall
senses.example: Actors with excellent [[recall]] can memorize pages of lines in a single evening.
senses.example_zh: 記憶力絕佳的演員，一個晚上就能背下好幾頁台詞。

gsat.sentence: My grandfather has astonishing powers of [[recall]]. He can still vividly describe his first day at school as a child.

senses.zh: 祕訣；（導致某結果的）因素
senses.en: a way or situation likely to lead to a particular result
senses.pattern: a recipe for success / a recipe for disaster / a recipe for happiness
senses.example: Hard work, patience, and a little luck are her [[recipe]] for success in the publishing business.
senses.example_zh: 努力、耐心加上一點運氣，就是她在出版業的成功祕訣。
senses.note: a recipe for disaster 必釀成災禍的做法

senses.en: a quiet, private place where one goes to rest
senses.pattern: a mountain retreat / a country retreat / a peaceful retreat / a retreat from the city
senses.example: The writer bought a small cabin by the lake as a [[retreat]] from the noise of the city.
senses.example_zh: 這位作家買下湖邊的一間小木屋，作為遠離城市喧囂的僻靜處。

senses.en: a period spent away for quiet thought or prayer
senses.pattern: go on a retreat / a meditation retreat / a weekend retreat
senses.example: After the exams, she joined a ten-day meditation [[retreat]] in the mountains, with no phone or internet.
senses.example_zh: 考完試後，她到山裡參加為期十天的冥想靜修，期間不用手機也不上網。
senses.note: 公司或團體的 retreat 指「共識營」

senses.en: one complete circular movement around a point
senses.pattern: one revolution around the sun / revolutions per minute / make a full revolution
senses.example: The Earth completes one [[revolution]] around the Sun in about 365 days.
senses.example_zh: 地球繞太陽公轉一圈大約需要三百六十五天。

senses.en: to cause something to start or develop suddenly
senses.pattern: spark a debate / spark interest / spark an idea / spark anger
senses.example: The science teacher's simple experiment with magnets [[sparked]] my lifelong interest in physics.
senses.example_zh: 自然老師用磁鐵做的簡單實驗，激起了我對物理一輩子的興趣。

gsat.sentence: It is believed that taking breaks from a problem can help [[spark]] a moment of insight or stimulate new ideas.

senses.en: a tube carrying blood through the body
senses.pattern: blood vessels / a blocked vessel / a burst blood vessel
senses.example: Regular exercise keeps your blood [[vessels]] flexible and lowers the risk of heart disease.
senses.example_zh: 規律運動能讓血管保持彈性，並降低罹患心臟病的風險。

senses.en: a container for holding liquids
senses.pattern: a drinking vessel / a clay vessel / a pressure vessel
senses.example: Scientists found a clay [[vessel]] that had been used to store olive oil two thousand years ago.
senses.example_zh: 科學家發現了一個兩千年前用來儲存橄欖油的陶製容器。

senses.en: to take back something you offered or said
senses.pattern: withdraw an offer / withdraw a remark / withdraw support / withdraw a complaint
senses.example: The company [[withdrew]] its job offer after discovering that he had lied about his degree.
senses.example_zh: 公司發現他謊報學歷後，撤回了這份工作邀約。

senses.en: to stop taking part in something; to move back
senses.pattern: withdraw from a competition / withdraw from the race / withdraw from the talks / withdraw from the city
senses.example: A knee injury forced her to [[withdraw]] from the tournament the day before the final.
senses.example_zh: 膝傷迫使她在決賽前一天退出這項錦標賽。

quiz.stem: Air quality monitors near the factory showed that the ______ of harmful particles was three times higher than the safety standard.
quiz.explain_zh: concentration＝濃度。工廠附近有害微粒的濃度是安全標準的三倍。

quiz.stem: Although the two writers lived in different countries and rarely met in person, their friendship ______ for more than fifty years through letters.
quiz.explain_zh: endure＝持續、持久。兩位作家雖少見面，友誼卻靠書信持續了五十多年。

quiz.stem: A short video of students cleaning a polluted beach ______ a nationwide movement, inspiring thousands of volunteers to organize similar events in their own towns.
quiz.explain_zh: spark＝引發。學生淨灘的短片引發全國性的行動，許多志工起而效法。

quiz.stem: Letting teenagers use smartphones in bed is a ______ for poor sleep, as the bright screens keep their brains awake long after midnight.
quiz.explain_zh: recipe＝（導致某結果的）因素。讓青少年在床上滑手機，必然造成睡眠不佳。

quiz.stem: Blessed with a strong ______, the 80-year-old farmer rarely catches a cold and still works in the rice fields every day.
quiz.explain_zh: constitution＝體質。老農夫體質強健，很少感冒，仍天天下田。

quiz.stem: Students will not receive their graduation certificates until all ______ library fines and lab fees, some of which were due months ago, have been paid in full.
quiz.explain_zh: outstanding＝未付清的。學生須繳清積欠的罰款與費用才能領畢業證書。

quiz.stem: The first few minutes after a person's heart stops are ______; without immediate help, the patient is unlikely to survive.
quiz.explain_zh: critical＝關鍵的。心跳停止後的頭幾分鐘決定病人能否存活。

quiz.stem: A lack of honest communication between parents and teenagers tends to ______ misunderstanding and distrust within a family, making small problems much harder to solve.
quiz.explain_zh: breed＝引起、釀成。親子間缺乏坦誠溝通，容易造成家中的誤解與不信任。

quiz.stem: Although e-books are cheaper and easier to carry, many readers still prefer a ______ book that they can hold, smell, and put on a shelf.
quiz.explain_zh: physical＝實體的。許多讀者仍偏好能拿在手上、擺上書架的實體書。

quiz.stem: The old lighthouse stands on a cliff that ______ the fishing village, offering visitors a wonderful view of the boats and the coastline.
quiz.explain_zh: overlook＝俯瞰。老燈塔矗立在俯瞰漁村的懸崖上，可飽覽船隻與海岸線。
